keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «엘라가 그리는 것마다 살아 움직인다(요술)» 와 «이제 엘라는 좋은 것만 그린다(결말)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the magic (everything Ella draws comes to life) and the ending (now Ella draws only nice things). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Everything Ella draws with the gold pencil comes to life.
Ella draws a big lion by mistake, and everyone runs.
Ella draws a big cage around the lion.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

opts: Ella draws a big lion by mistake.
evs: Then she draws a big lion by mistake.
She draws a cake. Yum! She can eat it.
Ella finds a gold pencil on the way to school.
Now Ella draws only nice things with her magic pencil.
why: «Then she draws a big lion by mistake.» 실수로 큰 사자를 그려서 사자가 살아났어요. 그래서 모두 도망가요.
Ella draws a big lion by mistake, and it comes to life. So everyone runs.

qs.q: "She draws a big lion by mistake." What does "by mistake" mean?
qs.qko: «She draws a big lion by mistake.» 에서 «by mistake» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
evs: Now Ella draws only nice things with her magic pencil.
She draws a cat, and the cat jumps off the paper!
Everything she draws comes to life!
She draws a cake. Yum! She can eat it.
why: «Now Ella draws only nice things with her magic pencil.» 엘라는 무서운 사자를 그리고 싶지 않았어요. 그래서 이제 좋은 것만 그려요. «by mistake» 는 «일부러가 아니라 실수로» 라는 뜻이에요.
Ella did not want a scary lion, so now she draws only nice things. "By mistake" means not on purpose.

qs.q: How does Ella stop the lion?
opts: She draws a cage, and it becomes a real cage around the lion.
She gives the lion some cake.
evs: She draws a big cage around the lion. Phew!
Everything she draws comes to life!
Ella finds a gold pencil on the way to school.
why: 엘라가 사자 둘레에 우리를 그리고(«She draws a big cage around the lion. Phew!»), 그린 것은 모두 살아나니까(«Everything she draws comes to life!») 진짜 우리가 사자를 가둬요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Ella draws a big cage around the lion, and everything she draws comes to life. So a real cage stops the lion. You need both sentences.

ends: Ella draws a rainbow, and the whole class rides on it.
엘라가 무지개를 그리고, 반 친구들이 모두 그 위를 탄다.
Ella loses the gold pencil, and a new friend finds it.
엘라가 금색 연필을 잃어버리고, 새 친구가 그것을 줍는다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because my friend likes it)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because my friend likes it)
write.src: “I want to <u>draw a cake</u> because <u>I can eat it</u>.”

img.cover: In a bright classroom, a girl with curly brown hair in a purple beret and a blue dress with white socks draws with a shiny gold pencil on a big sheet of paper, and a big fluffy lion with a golden mane and a round friendly face leaps out of the paper with its mouth wide open, while her classmates run around in a funny panic.

scenes.1: Close-up: a girl with curly brown hair in a purple beret and a blue dress happily takes a big bite of a slice of real chocolate cake with a shiny gold pencil in her other hand, chocolate on her cheek, while just behind her shoulder the big round friendly face of a fluffy lion with a golden mane pops out of her drawing paper with its mouth wide open.
scenes.2: In a bright classroom, a girl with curly brown hair in a purple beret and a blue dress with white socks draws fast with a shiny gold pencil, and a big drawn cage appears around a big fluffy lion with a golden mane and a round friendly face, who sits inside looking surprised, while her classmates peek out from behind their desks and smile.
